description: Pre-registered corpus and questions for verification.md gates. Seed with text PDFs — expand question counts before claiming release.

contracts.embedding: multilingual-e5-small (INT8 Core ML; record exact indexVersion + file hash on each run)

notes: Do not tune fusion weights or refuse threshold against cherry-picked demos.

Failure samples remain placeholders under corpus/failures.
Set frozen=true only after corpus+questions reach targets and a baseline report is archived.
